top_stories.title: ChatGPT can peek at your Chrome tabs now
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has added a feature to ChatGPT that allows it to access and read users' open Chrome browser tabs. This expands ChatGPT's capabilities as an AI personal assistant with greater context awareness of what users are actively working on.

top_stories.title: Bringing GPT-Rosalind to academic research labs
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has introduced the Rosalind Academic Plan, a new offering designed to bring GPT capabilities to academic research laboratories. The plan aims to support researchers with AI tools tailored for scientific and academic work.

top_stories.title: Accelerating the search for antimicrobial peptides with Google Antigravity
top_stories.summary: Google DeepMind has published details on a new AI tool called Antigravity, designed to accelerate the discovery of antimicrobial peptides — a critical area of research given rising antibiotic resistance. The system uses AI to navigate the vast search space of potential peptide candidates.

top_stories.title: AI Hacks Leave a Mess That AI Companies Aren't Paying For [Metered]
top_stories.summary: Wired investigates a growing pattern in which AI systems are exploited by attackers, causing real-world harm to individuals and organisations, while the AI companies behind the products largely avoid financial or legal accountability. The piece examines the gap between AI deployment speed and security responsibility.

top_stories.title: Teaching students to think and learn through questions
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has published a post outlining an educational approach using ChatGPT to encourage Socratic-style questioning rather than direct answer provision. The initiative is aimed at fostering deeper student engagement and critical thinking in AI-assisted learning environments.

further_links.title: How Meta Built Forum With AI-Native Engineering
further_links.summary: Meta's engineering blog details how the company used AI-native development practices to build Forum, its new social application, integrating AI tooling throughout the engineering process.

further_links.title: Meta and Apple team up to make Muse AI models run better on Macs
further_links.summary: Meta and Apple have collaborated to optimise Meta's open Muse AI models to run more efficiently on Apple hardware using the MLX framework.

further_links.title: Simons Foundation launches $15M effort to help mathematicians navigate AI era
further_links.summary: The Simons Foundation is investing $15 million to support mathematicians in understanding and engaging with AI tools and methods as they increasingly intersect with mathematical research.

further_links.title: Bluesky's AI tool now lets you make games and apps to share on social
further_links.summary: Bluesky has launched an AI-powered tool called Attie that enables users to build simple games and applications directly within the platform and share them socially.

further_links.title: Market selloff, rising rates test AI data centre deal boom
further_links.summary: Rising interest rates and market turbulence are beginning to strain the wave of financing behind AI data centre construction, raising questions about the sustainability of current AI infrastructure investment levels.

further_links.title: NVIDIA Expands Nemotron Family With Highest Efficiency Super VL and Bolt Models
further_links.summary: NVIDIA has announced new additions to its open Nemotron model family, including Super VL and Bolt variants designed for high efficiency from data centre to desktop deployments.

further_links.title: Nobody is safe from celebrity AI deepfakes
further_links.summary: The Verge reports on the proliferation of AI-generated deepfake images using celebrity likenesses on Instagram, highlighting the difficulties platforms face in policing synthetic media at scale.

further_links.title: Why We're Banning AI
further_links.summary: Current Affairs explains its editorial decision to prohibit the use of AI-generated content across its publication, citing concerns about quality, authenticity, and the broader cultural implications of AI in journalism.

further_links.title: Adobe and NVIDIA Expand Collaboration to Speed Agentic Creation
further_links.summary: Adobe and NVIDIA have announced an expanded partnership focused on accelerating agentic AI workflows for creative professionals, leveraging NVIDIA hardware and Adobe's creative software ecosystem.

further_links.title: Using AI to reverse engineer hardware
further_links.summary: A GNOME engineering blog post describes practical experiments using AI tools to reverse engineer hardware, demonstrating emerging use cases for AI in low-level technical analysis.
